author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the release date trailer for Point of No Return, a space opera roguelite developed by COKIRI Works. PNR is built around aggressive, head-on shooting combat. Rather than constantly dodging the barrage, players intercept incoming enemies and projectiles and break through the enemy fleet with overwhelming firepower. Each sortie also lets players create a different build by combining a variety of abilities and upgrades. Point of No Return is launching on August 28 for PC (Steam).
title: Point of No Return - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the release date trailer for Svetik, a dark atmospheric 2D top-down Adventure-RPG developed by AEVI Studio. Control a girl who lost her memory and her only companion — a living, sentient spark of sunlight. Light is your weapon, but it’s alive. Maintain trust with your glowing companion, or be left in pitch-black darkness during intense combat. Svetik releases on August 25 for PC (Steam), with a demo available now.
title: Svetik - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the release date trailer for Mythmon: Mythic Monsters, a monster-taming hack-and-slash auto-battler  developed by MachHabaneroGames. Fight back the Demon King’s armies with squads of Mythmon, ancient creatures brought back to life for their special abilities. Master elemental abilities to gain the upper hand, and plunder fallen enemies for their equipment to gather strength for the next battle. Mythmon: Mythic Monsters is launching on September 7 for PC (Steam).
title: Mythmon: Mythic Monsters - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the announcement trailer for Stray Dog: nobody cares, a Souslike game developed by Parry Frames Studio. Play as a stray dog who grips its master's frayed sword in its jaws and ventures forth to rescue the now-captured master. Stray Dog: nobody cares is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Stray Dog: nobody cares - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the release date trailer for Box Knight, a comedic action roguelike developed by We Made A Thing Studios. Players will fight, die, and repeat to become the Box Knight. Brawl through a monster-infested office, floor by floor, boss by boss, in this irreverent action roguelike. Box Knight is launching on August 25 for PC (Steam).
title: Box Knight - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the announcement trailer for Her Revenge, a first-person psychological horror experience developed by Sibghat Games and Sajjad Chandioset. The game is set entirely inside a sealed apartment building. You are thrown into the center of a massive, terrifying misunderstanding. Discover the horrific truth of Grandma's story, and find a way to stop her from finding you. You must first find out what happened and then END the madness. There's a secret room somewhere in the apartment, which will answer all your questions. Silence is Survival. You are not alone. Her Revenge is launching on PC (Steam) in September 2026.
title: Her Revenge - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the gameplay trailer for HIIT: Stranded on Zaruma, a 3D puzzle-platformer exploration game developed by Fisco Games. Trapped on the mysterious planet Zaruma, use tools like the Drone, Scanner, and Hookshot to explore the ruins of an ancient civilization and uncover what happened before your arrival. HIIT: Stranded on Zaruma launches on PC (Steam) in 2027.
title: HIIT: Stranded on Zaruma - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the gameplay trailer for A Sector Darkly, a single-player 2D space exploration RPG developed by A Paradise Lost Studios. Your ship and crew are lost in an unknown region, but finding your way home is the least of your problems. A war rages across the sector threatening to consume everything. While the war rages, sectors are going dark one by one, and no one knows why. Players must survive the chaos, solve the mystery of the dark sectors, and get their crew home. Command one ship and its crew in a living sector where trade, conflict, exploration, and alien agendas continue in real time. A Sector Darkly is planned for release in Q4 2026 on PC (Steam).
title: A Sector Darkly - Official Gameplay Trailer
